fields.Name: AIUsageCacheEfficiency
fields.UserQuestion: What is our prompt caching hit rate and estimated cost savings across models and prompts?
fields.Description: Calculates prompt cache efficiency metrics per model and prompt, including cache read token volume, cache read share, and estimated financial savings based on model pricing tiers.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups vwAIUsageFacts by ModelID and PromptID, joining vwAIModelCosts to evaluate the price delta between standard prompt input and cached prompt reads. Supports optional start and end date filtering.
